T01.title: Welcome, Scribbler!
T01.rule: New installation → choose a local starter profile. Continue is available without a network account.

T02.title: Choose your name
T02.subtitle: Step 1 of 5 · Meet your coach
T02.rule: Default valid name shown. Empty or rejected text stays here with inline feedback; edit before continuing.

T03.title: Select a card
T03.subtitle: Step 2 of 5 · Training · FREE
T03.rule: Only the highlighted Knight is enabled in tutorial. No competitive opponent or entry cost.

T04.title: Deploy your Knight
T04.subtitle: Step 2 of 5 · Training · FREE
T04.rule: Selecting a card does not spend elixir. Tap a valid own-side tile to commit deployment.

T05.title: Defend, then attack
T05.subtitle: Step 3 of 5 · Training · FREE
T05.rule: Repeat deploy with timing. After the coach match ends, advance to reward. Retry stays free.

T06.title: Your first victory!
T06.subtitle: Step 3 of 5 · Training complete
T06.rule: Practice reward is granted once by tutorial checkpoint, including after reconnect.

T07.title: Open your first chest
T07.subtitle: Step 4 of 5 · Instant tutorial unlock
T07.rule: Starter Chest skips its timer. Explain later chest timers only after this instant reward.

T08.title: New cards!
T08.subtitle: Step 4 of 5 · Rewards added
T08.rule: Reveal is cosmetic. Grants are recorded once before animation; skipping never loses rewards.

T09.title: First upgrade
T09.subtitle: Step 5 of 5 · Spend Gold + card copies
T09.rule: Tutorial upgrade cost 100 Gold + 10 copies. Confirm deducts both once; no gems required.

T10.title: Ready for the arena
T10.subtitle: Tutorial complete · Knight is Level 2
T10.rule: Grant first full ticket refill only once. Land on the normal hub with next goals and chest slots.

B01.title: Royal Arena
B01.subtitle: Scribbler_01 · Level 2 · 320 trophies
B01.rule: Hub prioritizes one battle CTA, chest queue and live event. Wallet + routes open contextual resource screens.

B02.title: Choose a mode
B02.subtitle: Tickets apply to ranked and event battles
B02.rule: Training is free and grants no ranked/event rewards. Event entry preserves its event ID.

B03.title: Ready to battle?
B03.subtitle: Ranked 1v1 · Royal Gardens
B03.rule: Validate ticket count, 8-card deck and chest capacity before reserving entry. Full slots offer explicit choice H07.

B04.title: Finding opponent
B04.subtitle: Ranked 1v1 · Estimated wait: 10 sec
B04.rule: Cancel releases reservation. A late match-found response wins only if server has committed start; otherwise cancel wins.

B05.title: Battle in progress
B05.subtitle: Ranked 1v1 · Ticket spent: 5 → 4
B05.rule: Wallet is hidden in live play. Card selects then valid tile spends elixir; unavailable cards disabled. Menu never pauses multiplayer.

B06.title: Victory!
B06.subtitle: 3 crowns to 1 · Ranked result
B06.rule: Result settles trophies and reward grant once using match ID. Claim returns to hub; capacity is handled before queue.

B07.title: Defeat
B07.subtitle: 1 crown to 3 · Try a different approach
B07.rule: Ticket is consumed; no chest is earned. Event crowns from completed play may still count. Rematch revalidates ticket and deck.

B08.title: Battle tickets
B08.subtitle: 0 / 5 · Next free ticket in 12:36
B08.rule: Example economy: +1 ticket / 30 min up to 5. Buy only missing tickets; free training always available. Server validates refill amount and price.

B09.title: Confirm ticket refill
B09.subtitle: Get back into battle
B09.rule: Confirm uses current quote. If ticket regenerated, recalculate and request confirmation if price changes. Never silently overcharge.

H01.title: Silver Chest
H01.subtitle: Slot 4 · Locked
H01.rule: Locked chest occupies one slot. Start unlock is free; if another is running, branch H08 without starting a second timer.

H02.title: Chest unlocking
H02.subtitle: Slot 4 · Silver Chest
H02.rule: Timer continues while offline. Push prompt is optional; returning after deadline opens Ready state. No need to keep the game open.

H03.title: Finish unlocking?
H03.subtitle: Silver Chest · 2h 14m remaining
H03.rule: Gem quote is revalidated. If chest became ready during confirmation, charge zero and open Ready. Cancel preserves timer.

H04.title: Your chest is ready!
H04.subtitle: Slot 4 · Silver Chest
H04.rule: Open requests the server reward grant. Disable repeated taps while response is pending.

H05.title: Chest rewards
H05.subtitle: 1 of 3 · Tap to reveal next reward
H05.rule: Reward grant already committed. Skip reveals all; disconnect resumes reveal without rerolling contents.

H06.title: Rewards collected
H06.subtitle: Silver Chest · Slot 4 is now empty
H06.rule: Example contents: +120 Gold, +10 Knight, +1 Archer. Collection badges update; chest slot clears on confirmed grant.

H07.title: Your chest slots are full
H07.subtitle: Choose what to do before battling
H07.rule: Do not silently discard an earned chest. Explicitly allow play without chest, or return to unlock/open. Trophies and Gold still count.

H08.title: One chest at a time
H08.subtitle: Another chest is already unlocking
H08.rule: Starting another chest is blocked; there is no paid hidden queue. Keep selected chest locked while current timer runs.

H09.title: Rewards are safe
H09.subtitle: You opened this chest before reconnecting
H09.rule: Resume committed reward set by chest ID. Never repeat the grant or reroll after a crash.

H10.title: Chest contents
H10.subtitle: Example table · Arena 2 Silver Chest
H10.rule: Illustrative guaranteed bundle, not Clash Royale odds. Publish complete per-item probabilities for randomized purchased rewards before purchase.

D01.title: Cards & battle deck
D01.subtitle: Deck 1 · 8 / 8 cards · Avg elixir 3.4
D01.rule: Selecting a collection card opens its detail; deck edit uses explicit replace slot. Upgrade badges reflect affordability and copies.

D02.title: Knight
D02.subtitle: Common · Melee troop · 3 elixir
D02.rule: Show present and next-level stats, copies and Gold requirement before purchase. Upgrade CTA blocked only if no valid resources.

D03.title: Confirm upgrade
D03.subtitle: Knight · Level 2 → Level 3
D03.rule: Deduct Gold and copies atomically; increment card level once. Client refreshes on stale inventory before resubmitting.

D04.title: Knight upgraded!
D04.subtitle: Level 3 · Ready for your next battle
D04.rule: Success persists after navigation. New card level reflected in active deck and battle preparation.

D05.title: Edit battle deck
D05.subtitle: Tap a slot to replace it · Deck 2
D05.rule: Example slot selection. Replace keeps cards unique. Save disabled when fewer than eight valid cards; show inline reason.

D06.title: Trophy Road
D06.subtitle: Royal Gardens · 320 trophies
D06.rule: Claim once per milestone. Unlock gates depend on trophies and never auto-open a paid flow.

D07.title: Find cards
D07.subtitle: Collection filters and missing copies
D07.rule: Filter tabs stay local. Missing-copy branch points to earning sources; no direct gem substitution without an explicit offer.

W01.title: Shop
W01.subtitle: Daily reset in 08:12:34
W01.rule: Show currency symbols and full quantities. Gold and Gems have distinct labels even in grayscale. No automatically selected purchase.

W02.title: Get Gems
W02.subtitle: Hard currency · choose a pack
W02.rule: Sample USD prices only; use localized platform catalogue. Purchased Gems do not grant battle power directly without an additional explicit action.

W03.title: Buy Gold
W03.subtitle: Exchange Gems for soft currency
W03.rule: Gems-to-Gold exchange is a one-time quoted transaction. Cancel returns unchanged; insufficient Gems sends W05 preserving return intent.

W04.title: Not enough Gold
W04.subtitle: Knight upgrade costs 400 Gold
W04.rule: Do not silently spend Gems to complete upgrade. Earn or exchange then return to card detail with fresh inventory.

W05.title: Not enough Gems
W05.subtitle: Example: ticket refill needs 20 Gems
W05.rule: Preserve return_to and quoted product. A completed Gem purchase returns to the original confirmation; never auto-spend the new balance.

W06.title: Confirm in the store
W06.subtitle: 80 Gems · $0.99 USD example
W06.rule: OS-controlled purchase sheet is schematic. It requires platform authentication; demo controls simulate success/cancel/pending and never charge money.

W07.title: Purchase delivered
W07.subtitle: Your wallet has been updated
W07.rule: Receipt-specific summary must display actual items, cost and balances. Repeated delivery attempts are idempotent.

W08.title: Verifying purchase
W08.subtitle: Please wait · do not purchase again
W08.rule: Platform success is not entitlement. Retry verification with same transaction; close keeps background reconciliation. Never ask for another payment.

W09.title: Purchase cancelled
W09.subtitle: No Gems were added
W09.rule: Cancelled/failed checkout never grants or charges in game. If platform reports charged, reconcile receipt instead of initiating a second purchase.

W10.title: Gems delivered
W10.subtitle: 80 Gems added to your account
W10.rule: Example checkout delivery. Preserve the original reason for purchase; refill is still explicitly confirmed on next screen.

L01.title: Events
L01.subtitle: Season 4 · 12 days remaining
L01.rule: Event hub order: claimable, active, upcoming, locked. Do not show every promotion as a blocking modal.

L02.title: Crown Rush
L02.subtitle: Ends in 2d 04h · Claim ends 24h later
L02.rule: First entry includes rules; recurring visits foreground progress. Completed battles grant crowns; late/disconnected results follow explicit policy.

L03.title: How Crown Rush works
L03.subtitle: Active event · 2 days remaining
L03.rule: Display scoring, tie, entry, cap, reward and settlement policy. Example parameters are editable per event config.

L04.title: Crown milestones
L04.subtitle: 5 crowns earned · one reward ready
L04.rule: Claim once per event/milestone/player key. If inventory full, event chest opens instantly or is held in inbox; never silently dropped.

L05.title: Crown leaderboard
L05.subtitle: Your rank #24 · updates after matches
L05.rule: While active, rankings are provisional. Ties share rank reward; final server settlement determines grant.

L06.title: Calculating results
L06.subtitle: Crown Rush has ended
L06.rule: Disable score entry at deadline. Wait for late-match grace plus validation; show no premature final entitlement.

L07.title: Royal Season Pass
L07.subtitle: Season 4 · 12d remaining · Tier 3
L07.rule: Two clearly separated tracks. Premium purchase unlocks eligible past tiers but does not automatically claim; free track remains usable.

L08.title: Upgrade Season Pass
L08.subtitle: Season 4 only · expires in 12d
L08.rule: Before real-money checkout show season expiry and eligible premium backlog. Example local price; no auto-renewal in this configuration.

L09.title: Confirm Premium Pass
L09.subtitle: Season 4 · $4.99 USD example
L09.rule: Separate SKU from Gems. Entitlement verified before opening premium claims. Cancel or pending preserves free pass.

L10.title: Final event reward
L10.subtitle: Crown Rush · Final rank #24
L10.rule: Claim leaderboard grant once; deadline 24h after end. After deadline send unclaimed reward to inbox using same grant key.

L11.title: Event closed
L11.subtitle: Crown Rush is no longer active
L11.rule: Expired deep links never enroll the player. Automatic mail uses original event reward grant ID, not a duplicate new reward.

L12.title: Inbox
L12.subtitle: Rewards and game messages
L12.rule: Inbox rewards have clear source and expiry. Claim idempotently; a full ticket balance permits reward overflow above regen cap.

L13.title: Daily goals
L13.subtitle: Resets in 08:12:34
L13.rule: Daily claims use reset instance IDs; no accidental streak loss from client time zone. Full ticket grants overflow cap; regen pauses above cap.

L14.title: Grand Challenge
L14.subtitle: Unlock at Arena 3
L14.rule: Locked event is discoverable with a clear progress gate. No Gem bypass for arena eligibility in this configuration.

L15.title: Event battle ready
L15.subtitle: Crown Rush · 1 ticket · 3 / 10 crowns
L15.rule: Validate current event eligibility and deadline before reserving ticket. Event context remains attached through match and result.

L16.title: Reward claimed
L16.subtitle: Added to your account
L16.rule: Summary must use actual claim payload. Demonstration shows a milestone Gold claim; other reward types use the same receipt shell.

L17.title: Premium unlocked
L17.subtitle: Season 4 · Tier 3 rewards available
L17.rule: Premium entitlement enabled after verified receipt. Use the same claim keys for retroactive tier claims; do not grant twice.

L18.title: Verifying Premium Pass
L18.subtitle: Your purchase is pending
L18.rule: Keep free track active while verification runs; retry same receipt. No second charge. Entitlement arrival produces L17.

L19.title: Premium rewards
L19.subtitle: Tier 3 · Premium active
L19.rule: Claim each tier once. Clearly distinguish claimed, ready and locked progress states.

S01.title: Clans
S01.subtitle: Find a team to trade cards and earn rewards
S01.rule: Preview before joining. Join requires eligibility and available slot; open clans join directly, invite-only clans show request pending.

S02.title: Royal Doodlers
S02.subtitle: 42 / 50 members · Open clan
S02.rule: Join checks capacity again. If full, show same view with inline reason and browse alternative clans.

S03.title: Royal Doodlers
S03.subtitle: 43 / 50 members · Clan chat
S03.rule: Card request cooldown and donation caps server-driven. Use preset messages in prototype; production text requires moderation/reporting.

S04.title: Clan Chest Weekend
S04.subtitle: Starts tomorrow · lasts 3 days
S04.rule: Upcoming state uses start timestamp. When active, only members enrolled before cutoff contribute; reward eligibility requires 5 personal crowns.

S05.title: Player actions
S05.subtitle: InkKnight · clan member
S05.rule: Mute is local; report requires a reason and confirmation, then returns to context. Match emotes are contextual variants, not moderation UI.

S06.title: Request cards
S06.subtitle: Knight · Common · 20 owned
S06.rule: One active request per player; cooldown 8h example. Cannot request locked or ineligible rarities. Claim donations once.

R01.title: Battle menu
R01.subtitle: The battle continues while this menu is open
R01.rule: Multiplayer cannot pause. Leaving asks for explicit confirmation in production; reconnect may still rejoin if match remains active.

R02.title: Reconnecting…
R02.subtitle: Trying to restore your battle
R02.rule: Rejoin same match ID; never consume another ticket. If match finished show authoritative result; server cancellation refunds once.

R03.title: Save your progress
R03.subtitle: Connect an account or continue as guest
R03.rule: Use platform identity. Conflicting saves need explicit selection with progress previews; never merge currency wallets blindly.

R04.title: Settings
R04.subtitle: Preferences and account
R04.rule: Settings changes persist. Accessibility includes text/readability and reduced motion; permissions remain OS controlled.

R05.title: Help & purchase support
R05.subtitle: Choose an issue
R05.rule: Support receives transaction IDs, not payment credentials. Recheck entitlement before suggesting another checkout. Example report is a local demo.

R06.title: Reminders
R06.subtitle: Choose what you want to hear about
R06.rule: Ask contextual permission only after user opts in. Denied permission falls back to in-game timers; do not repeatedly reprompt.

R07.title: Choose saved progress
R07.subtitle: Two saves were found
R07.rule: Show both progress snapshots and last played date. Confirm replacement with explicit preview; server protects purchased entitlements during reconciliation.

R08.title: Load cloud progress?
R08.subtitle: Replace this device’s active save
R08.rule: Explicit destructive-save confirmation; retain recovery snapshot. Entitlement reconciliation belongs to account service, not client totals.

B10.title: Battle tickets
B10.subtitle: 5 / 5 · Fully refilled
B10.rule: At cap, regeneration pauses and refill is unavailable. Reward-granted tickets may exceed this cap; do not discard them.

H11.title: Chest rewards
H11.subtitle: 2 of 3 · Rare card
H11.rule: Second reveal from the same immutable chest receipt; skip advances to summary without changing rewards.

H12.title: Chest rewards
H12.subtitle: 3 of 3 · Gold
H12.rule: Final reveal before summary. Gold was granted once on opening, not again on this animation.

W11.title: Daily Gold claimed
W11.subtitle: Come back after the next daily reset
W11.rule: Daily gift uses a reset-instance claim key. Repeat taps and relaunch do not award it again.

W12.title: Confirm in the store
W12.subtitle: 500 Gems · $4.99 USD example
W12.rule: Pack ID and localized price are preserved through checkout and verification. Never substitute another pack after selection.

W14.title: Verifying purchase
W14.subtitle: 500 Gems · receipt pending
W14.rule: Retry verification of this same pack/transaction; close continues background delivery. Never charge again.

W16.title: Gems delivered
W16.subtitle: 500 Gems added
W16.rule: Delivery uses the same transaction ID and original pack. Return to prior action requires another explicit spend confirmation.

W13.title: Confirm in the store
W13.subtitle: 1,200 Gems · $9.99 USD example
W13.rule: Pack ID and localized price are preserved through checkout and verification. Never substitute another pack after selection.

W15.title: Verifying purchase
W15.subtitle: 1,200 Gems · receipt pending
W15.rule: Retry verification of this same pack/transaction; close continues background delivery. Never charge again.

W17.title: Gems delivered
W17.subtitle: 1,200 Gems added
W17.rule: Delivery uses the same transaction ID and original pack. Return to prior action requires another explicit spend confirmation.

L20.title: Rank reward collected
L20.subtitle: Reward added to your account
L20.rule: Claim the original reward once. Ticket rewards may overflow the regeneration cap; already-claimed state replaces the button on return.

L21.title: Ticket claimed
L21.subtitle: Reward added to your account
L21.rule: Claim the original reward once. Ticket rewards may overflow the regeneration cap; already-claimed state replaces the button on return.

L22.title: Welcome-back reward
L22.subtitle: Reward added to your account
L22.rule: Claim the original reward once. Ticket rewards may overflow the regeneration cap; already-claimed state replaces the button on return.

L23.title: Premium Gems claimed
L23.subtitle: Reward added to your account
L23.rule: Claim the original reward once. Ticket rewards may overflow the regeneration cap; already-claimed state replaces the button on return.

L24.title: Premium Gold claimed
L24.subtitle: Reward added to your account
L24.rule: Claim the original reward once. Ticket rewards may overflow the regeneration cap; already-claimed state replaces the button on return.

L25.title: Banner unlocked
L25.subtitle: Reward added to your account
L25.rule: Claim the original reward once. Ticket rewards may overflow the regeneration cap; already-claimed state replaces the button on return.

L26.title: Finding event opponent
L26.subtitle: Crown Rush · 1 ticket reserved
L26.rule: Queue keeps event ID and scoring rules. Expiry before match start releases the ticket and returns to closed event.

L27.title: Crown Rush battle
L27.subtitle: Event match · 1 ticket spent
L27.rule: Score crowns for this event ID. Completed matches count within the 5-minute end grace; reconnect restores same match.

L28.title: Crown Rush result
L28.subtitle: 2 crowns earned · event progress updated
L28.rule: Apply match score once. Display milestone reach after the score settles; return to the same event, not generic ranked mode.

R09.title: Quick emotes
R09.subtitle: The battle continues
R09.rule: Preset emote selection returns to the battle. Respect mute and emote rate limits; no chat moderation screen is shown here.

D08.title: Archer
D08.subtitle: Card detail · Level 2
D08.rule: Reusable detail variant for selected card. This example is short of copies; show earning options and deck action rather than a misleading upgrade purchase.

D09.title: Giant
D09.subtitle: Card detail · Level 2
D09.rule: Reusable detail variant for selected card. This example is short of copies; show earning options and deck action rather than a misleading upgrade purchase.

D10.title: Zap
D10.subtitle: Card detail · Level 2
D10.rule: Reusable detail variant for selected card. This example is short of copies; show earning options and deck action rather than a misleading upgrade purchase.

D11.title: Goblins
D11.subtitle: Card detail · Level 2
D11.rule: Reusable detail variant for selected card. This example is short of copies; show earning options and deck action rather than a misleading upgrade purchase.

D12.title: Cannon
D12.subtitle: Card detail · Level 2
D12.rule: Reusable detail variant for selected card. This example is short of copies; show earning options and deck action rather than a misleading upgrade purchase.

D13.title: Fireball
D13.subtitle: Card detail · Level 2
D13.rule: Reusable detail variant for selected card. This example is short of copies; show earning options and deck action rather than a misleading upgrade purchase.

D14.title: Minions
D14.subtitle: Card detail · Level 2
D14.rule: Reusable detail variant for selected card. This example is short of copies; show earning options and deck action rather than a misleading upgrade purchase.

modules.title: FTUE · Learn → win → unlock → upgrade
modules.summary: 10 wireframes · A free practice duel teaches deployment before tickets, chests and the full hub appear.
modules.rule: Persist the last completed tutorial checkpoint. Tutorial match, retry and first chest are free; do not spend tickets or gems.

modules.title: Core battle · Tickets → deck → queue → result
modules.summary: 9 wireframes · Main hub, mode selection, preparation, matchmaking, actual battle HUD, results and ticket recovery.
modules.rule: One ticket is reserved in queue and consumed when the match starts. Queue cancel/timeout releases it; match loss consumes it; server-cancelled matches refund once.

modules.title: Chest lifecycle · Earn → unlock → wait → reveal
modules.summary: 10 wireframes · Locked, running, ready, speedup, queue conflict, full inventory and interrupted reveal.
modules.rule: Four slots; one running timer; default Silver Chest 3h. Free wait is always available. Server timestamp controls readiness; contents granted exactly once on open.

modules.title: Collection · Inspect → upgrade → build an 8-card deck
modules.summary: 7 wireframes · Card grid, stats, costs, confirmation, missing resources, deck repair and trophy progression.
modules.rule: Upgrade requires Gold and copies; Gems never silently substitute. Deck selection validates eight unique cards. Power and reward gates are configurable.

modules.title: Economy · Soft currency, hard currency & purchase states
modules.summary: 9 wireframes · Gold sources, Gem packs, platform checkout, shortfalls, verification, delivery and cancelled purchases.
modules.rule: Gold upgrades cards; Gems refill tickets, speed chests and buy explicit exchanges. Prices are illustrative. External checkout always returns verified entitlement or a recoverable pending state.

modules.title: Live ops · Discover → qualify → play → claim → settle
modules.summary: 14 wireframes · Events, rules, milestone rewards, leaderboard, season pass, purchase branch, expiry, inbox and returner.
modules.rule: Event examples use shared tickets and event-specific scoring. Server start/end/claim deadlines and eligibility govern every entry, score and reward.

modules.title: Clan & service · Join, request, contribute and recover
modules.summary: 12 wireframes · Clan discovery, requests, co-op chest, match menu, reconnect, account, settings, purchase support and reminders.
modules.rule: Social rewards share inventory and grant rules. Recovery never repeats ticket charges or reward grants. Multiplayer continues while menus are open.
